```{r}
# ============================================================================
# 5. NUMERICAL VARIABLES DISTRIBUTIONS (改进版)
# ============================================================================
library(ggplot2)
library(gridExtra)

# 确保只选择数值型变量
numerical_vars <- names(data)[sapply(data, is.numeric)]

# 数据验证和清理
for(var in numerical_vars) {
  cat("\n=== Checking", var, "===\n")
  print(summary(data[[var]]))
  print(paste("Range:", min(data[[var]], na.rm=TRUE), "to", max(data[[var]], na.rm=TRUE)))
  print(paste("Unique values:", length(unique(data[[var]]))))
}

# Histograms
plot_list_hist <- list()

for(var in numerical_vars) {
  if(is.numeric(data[[var]]) && length(unique(data[[var]])) > 5) {
    
    mean_val <- mean(data[[var]], na.rm = TRUE)
    
    # 特殊处理 debt_to_income_ratio
    if(var == "debt_to_income_ratio") {
      # 确保数据在 0-1 范围内
      if(max(data[[var]], na.rm = TRUE) > 1) {
        data[[var]] <- data[[var]] / 100
        mean_val <- mean(data[[var]], na.rm = TRUE)
        message("Converted debt_to_income_ratio to ratio scale")
      }
      
      # 设置合理的横轴范围
      p <- ggplot(data, aes_string(x = var)) +
        geom_histogram(fill = "steelblue", color = "black", bins = 30, alpha = 0.7) +
        geom_vline(aes(xintercept = mean_val), 
                   color = "red", linetype = "dashed", size = 1) +
        scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2)) +
        labs(title = paste("Distribution of", var),
             subtitle = paste("Mean:", round(mean_val, 2)),
             x = var, y = "Frequency") +
        theme_minimal() +
        theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
    } else {
      # 其他变量正常绘制
      p <- ggplot(data, aes_string(x = var)) +
        geom_histogram(fill = "steelblue", color = "black", bins = 30, alpha = 0.7) +
        geom_vline(aes(xintercept = mean_val), 
                   color = "red", linetype = "dashed", size = 1) +
        labs(title = paste("Distribution of", var),
             subtitle = paste("Mean:", round(mean_val, 2)),
             x = var, y = "Frequency") +
        theme_minimal() +
        theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
    }
    
    plot_list_hist[[var]] <- p
  }
}

# 绘制
if(length(plot_list_hist) > 0) {
  grid.arrange(grobs = plot_list_hist, ncol = 2, 
               top = "Histograms of Numerical Variables")
}


```

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# 6. OUTLIER DETECTION (IQR METHOD)
# ============================================================================
# Full script: Load -> Inspect -> Prepare -> Outlier detection (ignore size_of_downpayment)
# ============================================================================

# --- 0. Setup ---------------------------------------------------------------
set.seed(42)
library(ggplot2)
library(grid)
library(gridExtra)
# knitr::kable used for pretty tables if knitr available
if(!requireNamespace("knitr", quietly = TRUE)) {
  message("knitr not installed — results will print as data.frames")
}

# --- 1. Load data ----------------------------------------------------------
fname <- "car_loan_data_with_tenure.csv"
if(!file.exists(fname)) stop("File not found: ", fname, "\nPut the CSV in the working directory or change 'fname'.")
data <- read.csv(fname,
                 stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
                 na.strings = c("", "NA", "N/A"),
                 strip.white = TRUE,
                 fileEncoding = "UTF-8")

cat("Loaded dataset:", nrow(data), "rows x", ncol(data), "cols\n")

# --- 2. Quick structure & head ---------------------------------------------
cat("\n--- Structure ---\n")
str(data)
cat("\n--- First 6 rows ---\n")
print(head(data, 6))

# --- 3. Basic type conversions (keep minimal) ------------------------------
# Make sure commonly used categorical columns are factors
if("salary_range" %in% names(data)) data$salary_range <- as.factor(data$salary_range)
if("repaid" %in% names(data)) data$repaid <- as.factor(as.character(data$repaid))
if("repaid_loan_on_prev_car" %in% names(data)) data$repaid_loan_on_prev_car <- as.factor(as.character(data$repaid_loan_on_prev_car))

# Note: we intentionally DO NOT convert/clean size_of_downpayment here because user asked to ignore it.

# --- 4. Define numerical_vars and explicitly remove size_of_downpayment ---
# Auto-detect numeric columns then select the ones we want to analyse
numerical_vars <- names(data)[sapply(data, is.numeric)]

# Ensure typical expected numeric columns included (fallback)
expected_nums <- c("car_value", "debt_to_income_ratio", "loan_length", "driver_tenure", "size_of_downpayment")
# keep intersection but rely on detected numerics primarily
numerical_vars <- intersect(numerical_vars, expected_nums)

# Remove size_of_downpayment as requested
numerical_vars <- setdiff(numerical_vars, "size_of_downpayment")

if(length(numerical_vars) == 0) stop("No numeric variables selected for analysis after excluding size_of_downpayment.")

cat("\nNumeric variables to be analysed:\n")
print(numerical_vars)

# --- 5. Summary stats for chosen numeric vars ------------------------------
summary_stats <- data.frame(
  Variable = numerical_vars,
  Mean = sapply(data[numerical_vars], function(x) round(mean(x, na.rm = TRUE), 2)),
  Median = sapply(data[numerical_vars], function(x) round(median(x, na.rm = TRUE), 2)),
  SD = sapply(data[numerical_vars], function(x) round(sd(x, na.rm = TRUE), 2)),
  Min = sapply(data[numerical_vars], function(x) round(min(x, na.rm = TRUE), 2)),
  Q1 = sapply(data[numerical_vars], function(x) round(quantile(x, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE), 2)),
  Q3 = sapply(data[numerical_vars], function(x) round(quantile(x, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE), 2)),
  Max = sapply(data[numerical_vars], function(x) round(max(x, na.rm = TRUE), 2)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

cat("\nSummary statistics:\n")
if(requireNamespace("knitr", quietly = TRUE)) {
  print(knitr::kable(summary_stats, caption = "Summary Statistics for Numerical Variables"))
} else {
  print(summary_stats)
}

# --- 6. Robust outlier detector --------------------------------------------
detect_outliers <- function(x, k = 1.5) {
  # Force numeric and remove NA
  x_num <- as.numeric(x)
  x_num <- x_num[!is.na(x_num)]
  if(length(x_num) < 2) {
    return(list(count = 0, percentage = 0, lower_bound = NA, upper_bound = NA))
  }
  Q1 <- quantile(x_num, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
  Q3 <- quantile(x_num, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
  IQRv <- Q3 - Q1
  lower_bound <- Q1 - k * IQRv
  upper_bound <- Q3 + k * IQRv
  outliers <- (x_num < lower_bound) | (x_num > upper_bound)
  list(
    count = sum(outliers, na.rm = TRUE),
    percentage = mean(outliers, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    lower_bound = as.numeric(lower_bound),
    upper_bound = as.numeric(upper_bound)
  )
}

# Prepare summary table
outlier_summary <- data.frame(
  Variable = numerical_vars,
  Outlier_Count = integer(length(numerical_vars)),
  Outlier_Percent = numeric(length(numerical_vars)),
  Lower_Bound = numeric(length(numerical_vars)),
  Upper_Bound = numeric(length(numerical_vars)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

for(i in seq_along(numerical_vars)) {
  var <- numerical_vars[i]
  info <- tryCatch(
    detect_outliers(data[[var]]),
    error = function(e) list(count = NA, percentage = NA, lower_bound = NA, upper_bound = NA)
  )
  outlier_summary[i, "Outlier_Count"] <- info$count
  outlier_summary[i, "Outlier_Percent"] <- round(info$percentage, 2)
  outlier_summary[i, "Lower_Bound"] <- round(as.numeric(info$lower_bound), 2)
  outlier_summary[i, "Upper_Bound"] <- round(as.numeric(info$upper_bound), 2)
}

cat("\nOutlier summary:\n")
if(requireNamespace("knitr", quietly = TRUE)) {
  print(knitr::kable(outlier_summary, caption = "🔍 Outlier Detection Results (IQR Method, k=1.5)"))
} else {
  print(outlier_summary)
}

# --- 7. Boxplots for numeric vars ------------------------------------------
plot_list_box <- list()
for(var in numerical_vars) {
  # Use aes_string for programmatic var mapping
  p <- ggplot(data, aes_string(y = var)) +
    geom_boxplot(fill = "lightblue", color = "black", alpha = 0.7, na.rm = TRUE) +
    labs(title = paste("Boxplot of", var), y = var) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
  plot_list_box[[var]] <- p
}

# Arrange plots (2 columns)
if(length(plot_list_box) > 0) {
  do.call(grid.arrange, c(plot_list_box, ncol = 2, top = "Boxplots for Outlier Detection"))
} else {
  message("No boxplots to draw.")
}

# --- End -------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("\nDone. Note: 'size_of_downpayment' has been excluded from numeric analysis as requested.\n")


```

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# 7. CATEGORICAL VARIABLES SUMMARY

# Summary table for categorical variables
```

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# 8. BIVARIATE ANALYSIS - NUMERICAL VS TARGET
# ============================================================================

# Violin plots with boxplots (combines density and boxplot)
plot_list_violin <- list()
for(var in numerical_vars) {
  p <- ggplot(data, aes_string(x = "repaid", y = var, fill = "repaid")) +
    geom_violin(alpha = 0.5, trim = FALSE) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.8, outlier.size = 1) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("0" = "grey", "1" = "lightblue")) +
    labs(title = paste(var, "by Loan Repayment Status"),
         x = "Repaid", y = var) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "none",
          plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
  plot_list_violin[[var]] <- p
}

grid.arrange(grobs = plot_list_violin, ncol = 2, 
             top = "Violin Plots: Numerical Variables by Repayment Status")

# Statistical comparison with t-tests
comparison_results <- data.frame(
  Variable = numerical_vars,
  Mean_NotRepaid = numeric(length(numerical_vars)),
  Mean_Repaid = numeric(length(numerical_vars)),
  Difference = numeric(length(numerical_vars)),
  T_Test_PValue = numeric(length(numerical_vars)),
  Significant = character(length(numerical_vars)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

for(i in seq_along(numerical_vars)) {
  var <- numerical_vars[i]
  mean_0 <- mean(data[[var]][data$repaid == 0], na.rm = TRUE)
  mean_1 <- mean(data[[var]][data$repaid == 1], na.rm = TRUE)
  
  test_result <- t.test(data[[var]] ~ data$repaid)
  
  comparison_results[i, 2:6] <- c(
    round(mean_0, 2),
    round(mean_1, 2),
    round(mean_1 - mean_0, 2),
    round(test_result$p.value, 4),
    ifelse(test_result$p.value < 0.05, "✓ Yes", "✗ No")
  )
}

kable(comparison_results, 
      caption = "📊 Statistical Comparison by Repayment Status (T-Tests)")
```


```{r}
# Load required libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# Read data
data <- read.csv("car_loan_data_with_tenure.csv")

# Convert salary_range to factor
data$salary_range <- as.factor(data$salary_range)

# ============================================
# 1. BOX PLOT (Recommended)
# ============================================
ggplot(data, aes(x = salary_range, y = driver_tenure, fill = salary_range)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(title = "Driver Tenure by Salary Range",
       x = "Salary Range",
       y = "Driver Tenure (years)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# ============================================
# 2. VIOLIN PLOT (Alternative)
# ============================================
ggplot(data, aes(x = salary_range, y = driver_tenure, fill = salary_range)) +
  geom_violin() +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, fill = "white") +
  labs(title = "Driver Tenure Distribution by Salary Range",
       x = "Salary Range",
       y = "Driver Tenure (years)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# ============================================
# 3. SUMMARY STATISTICS
# ============================================
summary_stats <- data %>%
  group_by(salary_range) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean = mean(driver_tenure),
    Median = median(driver_tenure),
    SD = sd(driver_tenure),
    Min = min(driver_tenure),
    Max = max(driver_tenure),
    Count = n()
  )

print(summary_stats)

# ============================================
# 4. ANOVA TEST
# ============================================
anova_result <- aov(driver_tenure ~ salary_range, data = data)
summary(anova_result)

# ============================================
# 5. DENSITY PLOT (Overlay)
# ============================================
ggplot(data, aes(x = driver_tenure, fill = salary_range)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
  labs(title = "Driver Tenure Density by Salary Range",
       x = "Driver Tenure (years)",
       y = "Density",
       fill = "Salary Range") +
  theme_minimal()

```


```{r}
# Load required libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# Read data
data <- read.csv("car_loan_data_with_tenure.csv")

# Convert salary_range to factor
data$salary_range <- as.factor(data$salary_range)

# ============================================
# 1. SUMMARY STATISTICS
# ============================================
summary_stats <- data %>%
  group_by(salary_range) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean = mean(debt_to_income_ratio),
    Median = median(debt_to_income_ratio),
    SD = sd(debt_to_income_ratio),
    Min = min(debt_to_income_ratio),
    Max = max(debt_to_income_ratio),
    Q1 = quantile(debt_to_income_ratio, 0.25),
    Q3 = quantile(debt_to_income_ratio, 0.75),
    Count = n()
  )

print(summary_stats)

# ============================================
# 2. BOX PLOT (推荐)
# ============================================
ggplot(data, aes(x = salary_range, y = debt_to_income_ratio, fill = salary_range)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(title = "债务收入比 by 工资等级",
       subtitle = "Debt-to-Income Ratio by Salary Range",
       x = "工资等级 (Salary Range)",
       y = "债务收入比 (Debt-to-Income Ratio)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

# ============================================
# 3. VIOLIN PLOT
# ============================================
ggplot(data, aes(x = salary_range, y = debt_to_income_ratio, fill = salary_range)) +
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, fill = "white", outlier.alpha = 0.3) +
  labs(title = "债务收入比分布 by 工资等级",
       x = "工资等级",
       y = "债务收入比") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# ============================================
# 4. DENSITY PLOT (Overlay)
# ============================================
ggplot(data, aes(x = debt_to_income_ratio, fill = salary_range)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
  labs(title = "债务收入比密度分布 by 工资等级",
       x = "债务收入比",
       y = "密度",
       fill = "工资等级") +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2")

# ============================================
# 5. MEAN COMPARISON PLOT
# ============================================
mean_data <- data %>%
  group_by(salary_range) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean = mean(debt_to_income_ratio),
    SE = sd(debt_to_income_ratio) / sqrt(n())
  )

ggplot(mean_data, aes(x = salary_range, y = Mean, fill = salary_range)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Mean - SE, ymax = Mean + SE), 
                width = 0.2) +
  labs(title = "DIR by Salary Range",
       x = "Salary Range",
       y = "DIR") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# ============================================
# 6. ANOVA TEST
# ============================================
anova_result <- aov(debt_to_income_ratio ~ salary_range, data = data)
summary(anova_result)

# Post-hoc test (if ANOVA is significant)
tukey_result <- TukeyHSD(anova_result)
print(tukey_result)

# ============================================
# 7. CORRELATION (Spearman)
# ============================================
# Convert salary_range to numeric correlation analysis
data$salary_range_numeric <- as.numeric(data$salary_range)
cor_test <- cor.test(data$salary_range_numeric, 
                     data$debt_to_income_ratio, 
                     method = "spearman")
print(cor_test)

# ============================================
# 8. SCATTER PLOT WITH JITTER
# ============================================
ggplot(data, aes(x = salary_range, y = debt_to_income_ratio, color = salary_range)) +
  geom_jitter(alpha = 0.1, width = 0.3) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.5, outlier.shape = NA) +
  labs(title = "DIR by Salary Range",
       x = "Salary Range",
       y = "DIR") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# ============================================
# 9. EFFECT SIZE (Cohen's d)
# ============================================
library(effsize)

# 计算工资1级 vs 工资4级的效应量
group1 <- data %>% filter(salary_range == 1) %>% pull(debt_to_income_ratio)
group4 <- data %>% filter(salary_range == 4) %>% pull(debt_to_income_ratio)

cohen_d <- cohen.d(group1, group4)
print(cohen_d)

# ============================================
# 10. PERCENTAGE IN HIGH DEBT CATEGORY
# ============================================
```

```{r}
# 先确保所需包已加载
library(ggplot2)
library(gridExtra)
library(knitr)   # kable 用到
library(scales)  # percent

# --- 预检查与安全转换 ---------------------------------------------------
# 假设你的原表叫 data（如果不是，请改成实际名字）
# 确保 categorical_vars 存在且包含要画的列名
if(!exists("data")) stop("对象 'data' 未找到，请先加载数据到 data 变量。")
if(!exists("categorical_vars")) {
  # 例如自动检测（排除数值列）
  categorical_vars <- names(data)[sapply(data, function(x) is.character(x) || is.factor(x))]
}

# 明确排除目标列 'repaid'（以防重复）
categorical_vars <- setdiff(categorical_vars, "repaid")

# 将所有分类列强制为 factor（安全）
data[categorical_vars] <- lapply(data[categorical_vars], function(x) {
  if(is.factor(x)) x else as.factor(x)
})

# 规范化目标列 repaid：确保为 factor，levels 为 "0","1" 或 "Not_Repaid","Repaid"
if(!"repaid" %in% names(data)) stop("'repaid' 列不存在。")
# 尽量支持多种原始格式
if(is.numeric(data$repaid) || is.integer(data$repaid)) {
  data$repaid <- factor(as.character(data$repaid), levels = c("0","1"))
} else {
  data$repaid <- as.factor(as.character(data$repaid))
}
# 如果要用友好的图例标签，建立显示层级和值的映射：
# 找出当前 repaid 的实际 levels
repay_levels <- levels(data$repaid)
# 建立颜色映射，针对常见两个类自动处理
fill_map <- list()
if(all(c("0","1") %in% repay_levels)) {
  fill_map <- c("0" = "salmon", "1" = "lightgreen")
  fill_labels <- c("0" = "Not Repaid", "1" = "Repaid")
} else if(all(c("Not_Repaid","Repaid") %in% repay_levels)) {
  fill_map <- c("Not_Repaid" = "salmon", "Repaid" = "lightgreen")
  fill_labels <- fill_map
} else {
  # fallback：按现有 levels 分配颜色
  cols_use <- c("salmon","lightgreen","steelblue","orange")
  fill_map <- setNames(cols_use[1:length(repay_levels)], repay_levels)
  fill_labels <- setNames(repay_levels, repay_levels)
}

# --- 绘图（堆叠比例条形图） ----------------------------------------------
plot_list_cat_target <- list()
for(var in categorical_vars) {
  # 跳过不存在或单一水平的列
  if(!var %in% names(data)) next
  if(nlevels(data[[var]]) < 2) next
  
  p <- ggplot(data, aes_string(x = var, fill = "repaid")) +
    geom_bar(position = "fill", alpha = 0.85) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format()) +
    labs(title = paste(var, "vs Loan Repayment"),
         x = var, y = "Proportion", fill = "Repayment") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1),
          plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12))
  
  # 只有当 fill_map 的 names 与 data$repaid levels 对应时才手动设色和标签
  if(all(names(fill_map) %in% levels(data$repaid))) {
    p <- p + scale_fill_manual(values = fill_map, labels = fill_labels)
  }
  
  plot_list_cat_target[[var]] <- p
}

# 输出：若没有图则给提示
if(length(plot_list_cat_target) == 0) {
  message("没有可绘制的分类变量（或均为单一水平）。检查 categorical_vars 内容。")
} else {
  # 用 grid.arrange 分页显示（2列）
  do.call(grid.arrange, c(plot_list_cat_target, ncol = 2,
                          top = "Stacked Bar Charts: Categorical Variables vs Repayment"))
}

# --- 交叉表汇总（按行计算每个 category 的还款率） --------------------------
cat("\n📊 Cross-Tabulation with Target Variable (repayment rate by group):\n\n")
for(var in categorical_vars) {
  if(!var %in% names(data)) next
  if(nlevels(data[[var]]) < 2) next
  
  cat("-----", var, "-----\n")
  # 按行（每个 category）计算 repaid 为 Repaid 的百分比
  tab <- table(data[[var]], data$repaid)
  prop_row <- prop.table(tab, margin = 1)  # 每行的比例
  # 获取 repaid = positive level 名称（通常是 "1" 或 "Repaid"）
  positive_level <- if("1" %in% colnames(prop_row)) "1" else tail(colnames(prop_row), 1)
  # 输出表格（转为 %）
  out_tbl <- round(prop_row[, , drop = FALSE] * 100, 1)
  # 显示并用 kable 美化（如果在 notebook 中）
  print(kable(out_tbl, caption = paste("Repayment % by", var)))
  cat("\n")
}
```

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# 12. PRINCIPAL COMPONENT ANALYSIS (修正版)
# ============================================================================
cat("\n\n Starting PCA Analysis...\n")

# ✅ 正确定义PCA变量
pca_vars <- c("car_value", "debt_to_income_ratio", "loan_length", 
              "driver_tenure", "size_of_downpayment")

# 验证变量存在性
cat("Variables for PCA:", paste(pca_vars, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Checking if all variables exist in data...\n")

# 检查哪些变量实际存在
existing_vars <- pca_vars[pca_vars %in% colnames(data)]
missing_vars <- pca_vars[!pca_vars %in% colnames(data)]

if(length(missing_vars) > 0) {
  cat("⚠ Warning: Missing variables:", paste(missing_vars, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  cat("Available variables:", paste(existing_vars, collapse = ", "), "\n")
}

# 只使用存在的变量
pca_vars <- existing_vars

# 移除零方差列
vars_ok <- pca_vars[sapply(data[pca_vars], function(x) {
  is.numeric(x) && var(x, na.rm = TRUE) > 0
})]

cat("Variables passing variance check:", paste(vars_ok, collapse = ", "), "\n")

if(length(vars_ok) >= 2){
  
  cat("Performing PCA on", length(vars_ok), "numerical variables...\n\n")
  
  # 提取数据
  pca_data <- data[, vars_ok, drop = FALSE]
  
  # 移除缺失值
  pca_data <- pca_data[complete.cases(pca_data), ]
  
  # 验证数据类型
  if(!all(sapply(pca_data, is.numeric))) {
    stop("Non-numeric data detected in PCA input")
  }
  
  # 执行PCA
  pca <- prcomp(pca_data, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)
  
  # 计算解释方差
  explained_var <- (pca$sdev^2) / sum(pca$sdev^2)
  
  cat("✓ PCA computation successful\n")
  cat("  Total components:", length(explained_var), "\n")
  cat("  PC1 variance:", round(explained_var[1]*100, 1), "%\n\n")
  
  # ========================================================================
  # SCREE PLOT
  # ========================================================================
  
  scree_data <- data.frame(
    PC = 1:length(explained_var),
    Variance = explained_var,
    Cumulative = cumsum(explained_var)
  )
  
  p_scree <- ggplot(scree_data, aes(x = PC)) +
    geom_line(aes(y = Variance, color = "Individual"), linewidth = 1.2) +
    geom_point(aes(y = Variance, color = "Individual"), size = 3) +
    geom_line(aes(y = Cumulative, color = "Cumulative"), linewidth = 1.2) +
    geom_point(aes(y = Cumulative, color = "Cumulative"), size = 3) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0.8, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50", linewidth = 0.8) +
    scale_color_manual(
      name = "Variance Type",
      values = c("Individual" = "steelblue", "Cumulative" = "pink")
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, 1)) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:length(explained_var)) +
    labs(
      title = "PCA Scree Plot",
      subtitle = "Dashed line indicates 80% cumulative variance threshold",
      x = "Principal Component",
      y = "Proportion of Variance Explained"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
  
  print(p_scree)
  
  # ========================================================================
  # PC1 vs PC2 SCATTER PLOT
  # ========================================================================
  
  # 提取前两个PC
  n_pcs_plot <- min(2, ncol(pca$x))
  pca_scores <- as.data.frame(pca$x[, 1:n_pcs_plot, drop = FALSE])
  
  # 添加目标变量 - 确保索引匹配
  pca_scores$repaid <- factor(
    data$repaid[complete.cases(data[, vars_ok])],
    levels = c("0", "1"), 
    labels = c("Not Repaid", "Repaid")
  )
  
  # 移除缺失值
  pca_scores <- pca_scores[complete.cases(pca_scores), ]
  pca_scores$repaid <- droplevels(pca_scores$repaid)
  
  if(n_pcs_plot >= 2) {
    p_pca <- ggplot(pca_scores, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = repaid)) +
      geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +
      scale_color_manual(
        name = "Repayment Status",
        values = c("Not Repaid" = "pink", "Repaid" = "steelblue")
      ) +
      labs(
        title = "PCA: First Two Principal Components",
        subtitle = paste0(
          "PC1: ", round(explained_var[1]*100, 1), "% | ",
          "PC2: ", round(explained_var[2]*100, 1), "% | ",
          "Total: ", round(sum(explained_var[1:2])*100, 1), "%"
        ),
        x = paste0("PC1 (", round(explained_var[1]*100, 1), "%)"),
        y = paste0("PC2 (", round(explained_var[2]*100, 1), "%)")
      ) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
        legend.position = "bottom"
      )
    
    # 添加置信椭圆
    group_counts <- table(pca_scores$repaid)
    if(all(group_counts >= 3)) {
      tryCatch({
        p_pca <- p_pca + stat_ellipse(level = 0.95, linewidth = 1, linetype = "dashed")
      }, error = function(e) {
        cat("⚠ Could not add ellipses\n")
      })
    }
    
    print(p_pca)
  }
  
  # ========================================================================
  # LOADINGS TABLE
  # ========================================================================
  
  n_components <- min(3, ncol(pca$rotation))
  loadings_matrix <- pca$rotation[, 1:n_components, drop = FALSE]
  loadings_df <- data.frame(
    Variable = rownames(loadings_matrix),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  for(i in 1:n_components) {
    loadings_df[[paste0("PC", i)]] <- loadings_matrix[, i]
  }
  
  print(kable(loadings_df, digits = 3, caption = "PCA Loadings"))
  
  # ========================================================================
  # VARIANCE EXPLAINED TABLE
  # ========================================================================
  
  n_show <- min(5, length(explained_var))
  variance_df <- data.frame(
    Component = paste0("PC", 1:n_show),
    Variance_Explained = paste0(round(explained_var[1:n_show]*100, 1), "%"),
    Cumulative_Variance = paste0(round(cumsum(explained_var)[1:n_show]*100, 1), "%")
  )
  
  print(kable(variance_df, caption = "Variance Explained Summary"))
  
  cat("\n✓ PCA analysis completed successfully\n\n")
  
} else {
  cat("\n⚠ PCA skipped: Less than 2 numerical variables\n\n")
}
```

```{r}
# ============================================
# 智能 t-SNE 分析（自动处理所有问题）
# ============================================
library(Rtsne)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# ---------------------------
# 智能 t-SNE（含零方差保护 & PCA 降级改进）
# ---------------------------

numeric_features <- c("car_value","debt_to_income_ratio","loan_length","size_of_downpayment","driver_tenure")
available_features <- numeric_features[numeric_features %in% names(data)]
tsne_features <- data[ ,available_features, drop = FALSE]
tsne_labels <- data$repaid

# 强制数值
for(col in names(tsne_features)) {
  if(!is.numeric(tsne_features[[col]])) tsne_features[[col]] <- as.numeric(as.character(tsne_features[[col]]))
}
# 去掉全 NA 列（保险）
tsne_features <- tsne_features[, colSums(!is.na(tsne_features)) > 0, drop = FALSE]

# 完整行
keep <- complete.cases(tsne_features)
tsne_features <- tsne_features[keep, , drop = FALSE]
tsne_labels <- tsne_labels[keep]

n_total <- nrow(tsne_features)
cat("Available features:", paste(colnames(tsne_features), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Complete cases:", n_total, "\n")

# 如果样本极少，直接用 PCA（但先移除零方差列）
if(n_total < 10) {
  cat("⚠ Too few samples for meaningful t-SNE (n <", 10, "). Considering PCA fallback.\n")
  # remove zero-variance columns
  vars_var <- sapply(tsne_features, function(x) var(x, na.rm = TRUE))
  keep_vars <- names(vars_var)[is.finite(vars_var) & vars_var > 0]
  if(length(keep_vars) >= 2) {
    cat("Variables used for PCA:", paste(keep_vars, collapse = ", "), "\n")
    pca <- prcomp(scale(tsne_features[, keep_vars, drop = FALSE]), center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)
    pca_df <- as.data.frame(pca$x[,1:2])
    pca_df$label <- factor(tsne_labels)
    ggplot(pca_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = label)) +
      geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
      labs(title = "PCA (fallback) - first two PCs", x = "PC1", y = "PC2") +
      theme_minimal()
    stop("PCA fallback shown due to small sample size.")
  } else if(length(keep_vars) == 1) {
    single_var <- keep_vars[1]
    cat("Only one non-constant numeric feature (", single_var, "). Showing histogram.\n", sep = "")
    df <- data.frame(x = tsne_features[[single_var]], label = factor(tsne_labels))
    ggplot(df, aes(x = x, fill = label)) +
      geom_histogram(position = "identity", alpha = 0.5, bins = 30) +
      labs(title = paste("Distribution of", single_var), x = single_var, y = "Count") +
      theme_minimal()
    stop("Single-var histogram shown due to small sample size and single variable.")
  } else {
    stop("No valid numeric features left for PCA/t-SNE after removing zero-variance or NA columns.")
  }
}

# Remove zero-variance columns BEFORE scaling (this prevents prcomp/scale error)
vars_var <- sapply(tsne_features, function(x) var(x, na.rm = TRUE))
keep_vars <- names(vars_var)[is.finite(vars_var) & vars_var > 0]
if(length(keep_vars) == 0) stop("No numeric features with positive variance available for t-SNE/PCA.")
if(length(keep_vars) < length(colnames(tsne_features))) {
  removed <- setdiff(colnames(tsne_features), keep_vars)
  cat("Removed zero-variance columns:", paste(removed, collapse = ", "), "\n")
}
tsne_features <- tsne_features[, keep_vars, drop = FALSE]

# 标准化（现在安全）
tsne_data_scaled <- scale(tsne_features)

# 去重处理（若存在重复）
if(any(duplicated(as.data.frame(tsne_data_scaled)))) {
  cat("⚠ Duplicated rows detected — adding tiny jitter to avoid Rtsne duplicate error.\n")
  set.seed(42)
  jitter_mat <- matrix(rnorm(length(tsne_data_scaled), sd = 1e-8), nrow = nrow(tsne_data_scaled))
  tsne_data_scaled <- tsne_data_scaled + jitter_mat
}

# 参数选择
DESIRED_PERPLEXITY <- 30
max_perp_allowed <- floor((nrow(tsne_data_scaled) - 1) / 3)
perp_init <- min(DESIRED_PERPLEXITY, max_perp_allowed)
perp_init <- max(2, perp_init)  # at least 2

cat(sprintf("n=%d -> max_perp_allowed=%d -> initial_perplexity=%d\n", nrow(tsne_data_scaled), max_perp_allowed, perp_init))

perp_candidates <- unique(c(perp_init, 30, 20, 15, 10, 5))
perp_candidates <- perp_candidates[perp_candidates <= max_perp_allowed & perp_candidates >= 2]
if(length(perp_candidates) == 0) perp_candidates <- max(2, min(5, max_perp_allowed))

# 尝试 t-SNE
tsne_result <- NULL
perplexity_value <- NA
for(perp_try in perp_candidates) {
  cat("Trying perplexity =", perp_try, "...\n")
  try({
    set.seed(123)
    tsne_result_tmp <- Rtsne(
      tsne_data_scaled,
      dims = 2,
      perplexity = perp_try,
      verbose = FALSE,
      max_iter = 1000,
      check_duplicates = FALSE
    )
    if(!is.null(tsne_result_tmp$Y)) {
      tsne_result <- tsne_result_tmp
      perplexity_value <- perp_try
      cat("✅ t-SNE succeeded with perplexity =", perp_try, "\n")
      break
    }
  }, silent = TRUE)
}

# 若所有尝试失败，则降级到 PCA（并确保 PCA 输入无零方差）
if(is.null(tsne_result)) {
  cat("❌ All t-SNE attempts failed — falling back to PCA visualization.\n")
  # PCA 所需变量检查（已经移除零方差，但再确认）
  vars_var2 <- sapply(tsne_features, function(x) var(x, na.rm = TRUE))
  keep_vars2 <- names(vars_var2)[is.finite(vars_var2) & vars_var2 > 0]
  if(length(keep_vars2) >= 2) {
    pca <- prcomp(scale(tsne_features[, keep_vars2, drop = FALSE]), center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)
    pca_df <- as.data.frame(pca$x[,1:2])
    pca_df$label <- factor(tsne_labels)
    ggplot(pca_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = label)) +
      geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
      labs(title = "PCA (fallback) - first two PCs", x = "PC1", y = "PC2") +
      theme_minimal()
  } else if(length(keep_vars2) == 1) {
    single_var <- keep_vars2[1]
    df <- data.frame(x = tsne_features[[single_var]], label = factor(tsne_labels))
    ggplot(df, aes(x = x, fill = label)) +
      geom_histogram(position = "identity", alpha = 0.5, bins = 30) +
      labs(title = paste("Distribution of", single_var), x = single_var, y = "Count") +
      theme_minimal()
  } else {
    stop("No valid numeric features left for PCA fallback.")
  }
} else {
  # 成功绘图
  tsne_df <- data.frame(
    tSNE1 = tsne_result$Y[,1],
    tSNE2 = tsne_result$Y[,2],
    repaid = factor(tsne_labels, levels = c(0,1), labels = c("Not Repaid","Repaid"))
  )
  centroids <- tsne_df %>% group_by(repaid) %>%
    summarise(n = n(), meanX = mean(tSNE1), meanY = mean(tSNE2), .groups = 'drop')
  separation <- sqrt((centroids$meanX[1]-centroids$meanX[2])^2 + (centroids$meanY[1]-centroids$meanY[2])^2)

  p <- ggplot(tsne_df, aes(x = tSNE1, y = tSNE2, color = repaid)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1.8) +
    stat_ellipse(level = 0.9, linetype = 2, linewidth = 0.6, show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Not Repaid" = "pink","Repaid" = "steelblue")) +
    labs(title = "t-SNE Visualization", subtitle = sprintf("perplexity=%d | obs=%d | separation=%.2f", perplexity_value, nrow(tsne_df), separation)) +
    theme_minimal()
  print(p)

  cat("Summary:\n")
  print(centroids)
  cat(sprintf("Centroid separation = %.3f\n", separation))
}


```
